people.name: Stephen
people.line: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.

translations.web: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
translations.bsb: While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
translations.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
